selection: same original20 seed2026 permutation next3; no action-type quotas/no output-based replacement
training_labels: automatic evidence weighted proximity with independent separation; human ranges excluded
control: CF008 frozen; ambiguity-only arm internal control
change: unsupported motion is unknown; observed relative-pose consistency can retain positive evidence
training_split: four entire training episodes; former internal audit frames are now training and never reported as held-out
motion_models: measured hand rigid transport of same material surface
aggregation: quality weighted mean over reliable endpoint pairs without confidently separated intermediate frame
main_target: near_target on supported frames, zero only clear separation
main_weight: near_weight * automatic positive support; separation retains near_weight; unsupported zero
loss: weighted BCE interaction + 0.5 original proximity BCE +0.2 original world-motion SmoothL1
semantics: support for effective interaction under limited observation model; low score means unsupported/unknown unless independently separated
